Name: (CP)RUIN's Custom Stardew Valley Villager Portraits (Multi-Version)
Author: THE13RUIN
Description:
在好心的DacarTheGorilla的帮助下，做出了用代码显示高清肖像的新版本！这个新版本较大改变了模组使用方式（我个人觉得新版本用起来更方便），不过以防有人更喜欢原来的使用方式，我将原来“直接将纯PNG文件模组文件夹放入Portraiture模组中Portraits文件夹使用”的版本放入了可选文件中。如果之后有新内容更新，比如增加了新的可选肖像，这两种方式的文件都会更新的！
With the help of the kind-hearted DacarTheGorilla, a new version that displays HD portraits via code has been created! This new version significantly alters the mod's usage method (I personally find it more convenient to use). However, just in case some people still prefer the original way, I have included the old version—the one that requires "directly placing the folder of PNG files into the Portraits folder of the Portraiture mod"—in the optional files. If there are any future content updates, such as new optional portraits, both versions will be updated!

本模组需要下载[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]并安装[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]、[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]两个前置模组。并且如果要在游戏内切换本模组内的可替换肖像，还需要[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]通用模组配置菜单[/url]作为前置模组。
This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], along with two prerequisite mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url].Additionally, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]  is required as a prerequisite if you want to switch between the replaceable portraits included in this mod while in-game.


[b]安装教程（Installation Guide）:[/b]

首先下载SMAPI和前置模组，然后下载本模组，解压缩之后，我们将获得本模组主体文件夹和说明书两个文件。（模组文件中的“说明书Readme”文件中，有详细的关于本模组安装方式和各可替换版本图文说明。）把这个文件夹直接放入星露谷本地游戏文件夹的Mods文件夹中即可。进入游戏后，在对话时按“P”键切换肖像直至显示此模组肖像美化（通常对话框左上角显示HDP）。
First, download SMAPI and the required prerequisite mods, then download this mod. After extraction, you will obtain two items: the main mod folder and a file named 说明书Readme. (The ”说明书Readme“ file contains detailed installation instructions and explanations for each replaceable portrait version, including both text and images.)Place this folder directly into the Mods folder within your local Stardew Valley game directory.After entering the game, press the 'P' key during dialogue to cycle through portraits until the portrait from this mod is displayed (this is usually indicated by 'HDP' in the top-left corner of the dialogue box).

本模组可以通过通用模组配置菜单在游戏内切换本模组内的其他可选肖像版本。通用模组配置菜单在游戏标题界面左下角，或者游戏内按ESC出现的菜单的设置这一栏界面最下方可以找到。
如果你想使用本模组内的其他可选肖像版本中的某个版本，在通用模组配置菜单中找到本模组，然后勾选需要的版本即可。勾选完记得保存！注意：每个角色只能勾选一项！（想象一下吧，假如你给哈维同时勾选两项，哈维的肖像要怎么既有胡子又没胡子呢？一个角色当然只能显示一个版本的肖像啦）
This mod allows you to switch between its alternative portrait versions in-game using the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM). You can access the GMCM either from the bottom-left corner of the game's main title screen, or from the very bottom of the 'Settings' tab within the menu that appears when you press 'ESC' during gameplay.
If you wish to use one of the alternative portrait versions included in this mod, find this mod within the  Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) and check the box for the desired version. Remember to save your  changes after selecting!Note: You can only select one option per character! (Imagine this: if you selected two options for Harvey, how could his portrait have both a beard and be clean-shaven at the same time? A character, of course, can only display one version of their portrait!)
